name: It is a tradition to eat mooncakes during the Mid-Autumn Festival.
trans: 中秋节吃月饼是一个传统。

name: Traditional festivals play an important role in family reunion.
trans: 传统节日在家庭团聚中起重要作用。

name: The Spring Festival is the most important traditional festival in China.
trans: 春节是中国最重要的传统节日。

name: People celebrate the Dragon Boat Festival in memory of Qu Yuan.
trans: 人们庆祝端午节以纪念屈原。

name: This custom dates back to ancient times.
trans: 这一习俗可追溯到古代。

name: The tradition has been passed down from generation to generation.
Paper-cutting is a traditional Chinese folk art.
trans: 剪纸是中国传统民间艺术。

name: Peking Opera is regarded as a symbol of traditional Chinese culture.
trans: 京剧被视为中国传统文化的象征。

name: Traditional medicine still plays an important role in people’s lives.
trans: 传统医学仍在人们生活中发挥重要作用。

name: Modernization has changed some traditional lifestyles.
trans: 现代化改变了一些传统生活方式。

name: We should take measures to preserve traditional culture.
trans: 我们应采取措施保护传统文化。

name: Young people should inherit and promote traditional Chinese culture.
trans: 年轻人应传承和弘扬中国传统文化。

name: Some people prefer traditional methods, while others choose modern ways.
trans: 有些人喜欢传统方法，而另一些人选择现代方式。

name: It is necessary to respect local traditions when traveling.
trans: 旅行时尊重当地传统是必要的。

name: Traditional values still influence many people’s choices.
trans: 传统价值观仍影响许多人的选择。
